en: Vintage sepia postcard showing two ornate villas in a lush, terraced landscape, with a hill rising behind them. On top of the hill stands a castle‑like building flying a flag. The foreground is a garden or vineyard with plants and a low stone wall and fence. Printed German captions at the bottom identify the view as a scene from Niederlößnitz–Kötzschenbroda and name the hilltop building as Friedensburg. Publisher information appears along the bottom edge.
